'''Benx''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] living on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] occupation of the planet. Operating from the [[Sunken Sarlacc cantina]] in [[Sobrik]], he was forced by Sith [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Darth Lachris]] to use his computerized brain to process data for her.
